title: Secret store
description: keyhole.stores — an org-level secret store. Discriminated by `provider`; `auth` is discriminated by `method`. Each method is annotated x-route (either | connector_only) and x-stores-secret. Route rule: a method that is connector_only, an identitySource of connector_ambient, or networkExposure private all require route.mode connector. Stored secret material is only ever a secretRef (sealed in the Keyhole sealed-secret service, or connector_local). See stores.md.

oneOf.description: Local store: Keyhole holds the values itself (local_key_values), envelope-encrypted with a KMS key.

route.description: How Keyhole reaches the store. direct = from Keyhole's SaaS; connector = through a customer-run vault connector (the connector becomes org-level: only org admins manage it); internal = Local store.

identitySource.description: Whose platform identity signs the login. keyhole = Keyhole's own cloud principal, which the customer trusts (SaaS-direct possible). connector_ambient = the connector's instance/pod identity (connector only).

federation.description: Keyhole as OIDC issuer: nothing is stored; Keyhole mints a short-lived JWT per login (VAULT_FLOWS §1).

audience.description: `aud` Keyhole mints and the customer's config expects.
